svg.aria-label: 01 Open. Transparent and free to study, use and build on. Every solution is designed to be shared. 02 For everyone. Made to be picked up by makers, students and professionals alike. No gatekeeping. 03 Built together. Ideas, feedback and contributions are welcome from everyone.
